subject: Discovery recap and next steps — scheduling evaluation kickoff
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Jefferson <cjefferson@healthgrid.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap and next steps — scheduling evaluation kickoff

Hi Claire and Raj,

Thanks again for the conversation today — appreciate the candid details on latency pain with your current supplier and the mix of structured/unstructured prompts across clinical notes and patient messaging. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in an evaluation kickoff: 

Summary of needs (from our call)
- Low token latency for short responses (50–200 token range) for triage workflows
- Deterministic reranking for shardable batch scoring of patient messages
- Data controls: customer-managed keys + retention policy enforcement

Success criteria we’d validate in the 30-day eval
- 95th pctile inference latency < 220ms for 0–200 token requests under nominal load
- End-to-end cost target <= $0.0025 per short response at projected throughput
- No data leakage in prompt snapshots; retention configurable to 30/90 days
- Prompt accuracy baseline: match or improve your current F1 on the triage intent set by >=3 pts

Proposed evaluation kickoff (choose one):
- Tue Nov 16, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Nov 17, 13:00–14:00 PT (preferred for our infra team)
- Thu Nov 18, 09:00–10:00 PT

Proposed kickoff agenda (45–60m)
1) Introductions + roles (5m)
2) Align success criteria and scope (10m)
3) Trial plan and timeline (15m) — provisioning, sample prompt upload, data handling
4) Tech deep dive / infra requirements (20m) — who should attend from your side for this?

Pre-kickoff ask from us
- Share a short prompt pack (10–20 example prompts) and one small sample dataset (anonymized)
- Confirm any compliance questions up front (PII/PHI handling, SOC2 requirements)

Attachments: redwood-eval-playbook-v1.pdf (eval plan, roles, telemetry we collect)

If you confirm a slot, I’ll send a calendar invite and add a short pre-read folder with a sample prompt template. Marissa (cc’d) will lead the technical deep dive portion and will follow up on pre-kickoff items.

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182


From: Claire Jefferson <cjefferson@healthgrid.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@healthgrid.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Discovery recap and next steps — scheduling evaluation kickoff

Thanks Ben — useful recap.

Wed Nov 17 13:00–14:00 PT works for us (Raj and I are available). A couple quick items before the kickoff: 
- We need clarity on handling prompts that include PHI. Is Redwood able to support a strict no-retention mode and customer-managed KMS for keys?
- Our security team will want a SOC2 snapshot and a short questionnaire answered prior to provisioning. I’ve linked the questionnaire here: https://drive.healthgrid.com/sec-ask-2026 (internal).

Also please confirm times are PT — we’re in EST but converted. If you can send calendar invites in PT we’ll accept.

Attaching our pre-kickoff checklist (attachment stub): healthgrid-pre-kickoff-checklist.xlsx

Best,
Claire Jefferson
Director of Product, HealthGrid
claired@healthgrid.com | (212) 555-0134

Thanks — I’ll take point on the technical deep dive in the kickoff. A few quick notes on prep so we can hit the ground running: 

Pre-kickoff items (we’ll upload a folder with templates):
- HealthGrid: please upload a 10–20 prompt pack to this folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bEvalPromptPack (examples + expected outputs)
- If you can provide one anonymized sample file (CSV or JSON) with labels that’s ideal for baseline scoring
- Confirm which environment you want (hosted Redwood API sandbox vs. Dedicated trial nodes) — default is hosted sandbox unless you request dedicated capacity

Security/compliance
- Looping in Neha (cc’d) from our security team. Neha, can you schedule a 20m sync with Claire’s security lead to share the SOC2 snapshot and answer the questionnaire?

Agenda owners
- Ben: project plan and success criteria
- Marissa: architecture, provisioning, prompt ingestion, telemetry schema
- Neha: security & compliance readout (10–15m)

I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed Nov 17 13:00–14:00 PT once Claire confirms; if anything else is needed from our infra team before then let me know.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

Perfect — Wed Nov 17, 13:00–14:00 PT confirmed. I’ve sent a calendar invite here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-healthgrid-20261117 (please accept).

Quick answers to Claire’s security questions: 
- We support customer-managed KMS for both hosted and dedicated; we also offer a no-persistence mode for prompt inputs (ephemeral processing) for onboarding tests.
- Attaching a SOC2-highlevel PDF for your security team (SOC2-summary-2025.pdf). Neha will reach out to schedule the 20m security sync and fill your questionnaire prior to provisioning.

Next steps checklist
- Claire / Raj: upload prompt pack + anonymized sample to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bEvalPromptPack
- Neha: security sync with HealthGrid security lead
- Marissa: prepare provisioning checklist and baseline telemetry dashboard

If anything changes on availability I’ll re-open slots — otherwise see you on Nov 17.
